The '''Great Library of Cinnagar''' was a massive [[Library/Legends|library]] contained within a [[Bronze/Legends|bronze]]-domed building in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]] on [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]].

{{Struct-stub}}

==History==
A massive [[Library/Legends|library]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]], the Great Library was located on the borders of the [[Core District/Legends|Core District]] and the [[Royal District/Legends|Royal District]]. Designed in deference to the architectural wonder that was the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the mushroom-shaped building was filled with exhibits of [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta's]] history. The collections of the Great Library comprised the greatest collection of information on the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]], containing billions of stories, writings, [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]], novels, [[Painting/Legends|paintings]], artifacts, and transcripts. While many of the citizens of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] believed that the [[Qel-Droma Epics/Legends|Qel-Droma Epics]] were a fiction propagated by the defunct [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the [[Museum/Legends|museum]] took the view that the Epics were an accurate depiction of history. To this end, the Great Library featured a vast museum dedicated to the era of the [[Unification Wars (Koros)/Legends|Unification Wars]] and the subsequent [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Artifacts from this era and artistic recreations filled the displays, which most [[Tetan/Legends|Tetans]] honored with respect and awe.<ref name="NoP" />
